reuse.why: Adds the flag as a parameter of the existing getMonthWideCategories that setZero, the averages and last-month spending already use, and of the shared MonthWideArgs type.

duplication.why: No new logic is copied, but the hidden rule stays encoded twice (the SQL in getMonthWideCategories and copyPreviousMonth's own row check), each now toggled by the flag.

placement.why: The selection rule changes in the shared selection function in server/budget/actions.ts; actions only pass the flag through.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing and the conditional hidden filter.

maintainability.why: Easy to follow; copyPreviousMonth's separate filter, inherited from the tree, still needs to be kept in step with getMonthWideCategories.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getMonthWideCategories everywhere it was already used; copyPreviousMonth's separate filter predates the change and is only extended.
